title.zh: Anthropic 聘请埃森哲作为嵌入式评估方，以协助其人工智能放缓提案
title.en: Anthropic taps Accenture as embedded evaluator to help with AI slowdown proposal

current_state.zh: Anthropic 表示，已选择埃森哲作为其首个嵌入式评估方，以协助放缓人工智能发展步伐——这是其 CEO 达里奥·阿莫代伊于 9 月 12 日提出的三步提案的内容。该合作是非排他性的，如何实施的细节仍在制定中；Anthropic 与埃森哲各自预计将在未来五年内向该项目投入至少 10 亿美元。
current_state.en: Anthropic said it has chosen Accenture as its first embedded evaluator to help slow the pace of AI development as proposed by CEO Dario Amodei on Sept. 12. The partnership is non-exclusive and details of how it will work are still being worked out; Anthropic and Accenture each expect to invest at least $1 billion in the project over the next five years.
